properties.description:

The initiative falls within the context of the Development Policy Financing programme for fiscal sustainability and resilient growth, promoted by the World Bank for a total value of over USD 2.5 billion. Lake Boye is an artificial basin located near Jimma, in the Oromia region. The initiative follows previous Italian financing and supports the nation's health priorities, in particular maternal and reproductive health, nutrition, primary services and community-based health insurance. The intervention is consistent with the Italy–Ethiopia cooperation plan 2026-2028.

The initiative aims to strengthen the autonomy, dignity and social inclusion of people with intellectual and relational disabilities trained and introduced to work at the Cottolengo Mission Hospital in Chaaria, Meru County, offering them inclusive training pathways and sheltered employment opportunities.
